items.exampleEn: He has hairy arms and a long beard.
items.exampleZh: 他手臂毛很多，還留著長鬍子。

items.exampleEn: In sewing class, we practiced one simple stitch for an hour.
items.exampleZh: 在縫紉課上，我們花了一個小時練習一種簡單的針法。

items.exampleEn: Denim jackets never seem to go out of style.
items.exampleZh: 牛仔外套似乎永遠不會退流行。

items.exampleEn: Bikinis first appeared about eighty years ago.
items.exampleZh: 比基尼大約在八十年前首次出現。

items.exampleEn: Portrait painters mix many colors to show a natural complexion.
items.exampleZh: 肖像畫家會調和許多顏色，畫出自然的膚色。

items.exampleEn: She works as a fashion stylist for famous singers.
items.exampleZh: 她為知名歌手擔任時尚造型師。

items.exampleEn: A tiny eyelash fell into my eye.
items.exampleZh: 一根小睫毛掉進我眼睛裡。

items.exampleEn: My uncle trained for five years to become a jeweler.
items.exampleZh: 我叔叔受訓了五年，才成為珠寶匠。

items.sentenceEn: She has long, dark eyelashes just like her mother's.
items.sentenceZh: 她有一雙跟媽媽一樣又長又黑的睫毛。

items.audioEn: These denim jeans are on sale today for half price.
items.audioZh: 這些牛仔褲今天半價特賣。

items.sentenceEn: The stitches on this bag were made by hand, but you can hardly see them.
items.sentenceZh: 這個包包上的針腳是手工縫的，但幾乎看不出來。

items.sentenceEn: The jeweler checked the diamond under a bright light.
items.sentenceZh: 珠寶商在明亮的燈光下檢查那顆鑽石。

items.stemEn: My ____ suggested a new hair color that suits my skin.
items.stemZh: 我的髮型師建議了一個適合我膚色的新髮色。

items.stemEn: The giant spider had long, ____ legs, so I was too scared to touch it.
items.stemZh: 那隻大蜘蛛的腳又長又多毛，我嚇得不敢碰牠。

items.passageEn: Before my sister's wedding, the whole family got busy. The hair stylist's schedule was flexible, so she came to our house at six in the morning. My sister has a pale complexion, so the stylist chose soft pink colors and gently curled her eyelashes. My brother, who usually wears only denim, put on a suit for the first time in years. Our hairy dog even got a bow tie! The day before, my sister picked up her rings from the jeweler, and my grandmother added a few last stitches to her dress. After the wedding, my sister flew off on a beach holiday with nothing in her bag but a bikini and a book.
items.passageZh: 我的姊妹婚禮前，全家人都忙了起來。髮型師的時間很有彈性，所以早上六點就來到我們家。我的姊妹膚色白皙，於是髮型師選了柔和的粉色系，還輕輕地幫她把睫毛夾翹。平常只穿牛仔服的兄弟，好幾年來第一次穿上西裝。連我們家那隻毛茸茸的狗都戴上了領結！婚禮前一天，我的姊妹去珠寶店取了戒指，奶奶也在她的禮服上縫了最後幾針。婚禮過後，我的姊妹飛去海灘度假，包包裡只帶了一套比基尼和一本書。

questions.questionZh: 髮型師為什麼選柔和的粉色系？
options: 因為作者的姊妹喜歡粉紅色
因為作者的姊妹膚色白皙

questions.questionZh: 婚禮前一天，作者的姊妹做了什麼？

items.promptZh: 她的氣色看起來很健康。
referenceEn: She has a very healthy complexion.
Her complexion looks healthy and bright.
rubricZh: complexion 指「膚色、氣色」（例如 a healthy complexion）
可寫 She has… 或 Her complexion looks… 等

items.promptZh: 牛仔布很耐用，所以很適合拿來做工作服。
referenceEn: Denim is very strong, so it is good for work clothes.
Because denim lasts a long time, it is great for making work clothes.
rubricZh: denim 指「牛仔布」，不可數，動詞用單數（例如 Denim is… 等）
「耐用」可寫，例如 strong、lasts a long time、hard-wearing 等
「適合做工作服」可寫，例如 good for work clothes、great for making work clothes 等
